description: 令和6年能登半島地震 能登西部3次元点群データ(発災前 色付き・ジオイド高変換済み) [earthquakes] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 令和6年能登半島地震. 石川県が実施した「令和2年度 森林情報整備業務」で取得した、発災前の能登西部のLAS形式の３次元点群データを写真地図画像データと合成して東京都が作成したものです。 （このデータは、石川県が作成した測量成果を、石川県知事の承認を得て複製（承認番号 森管第1965号及び第1977号（令和５年度））し、加工したものです。 ） なお、国土... Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 令和6年能登半島地震. Its tags are 3次元点群データ, 令和6年能登半島地震, 能登西部. It offers 31 resource(s) in pdf, zip. The portal shows 2026-02-28 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is the data owner's own terms of use (see the dataset page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
